name: Pencil Sketch
traits: graphite strokes with visible pressure changes
construction lines and searching marks left in
off-white sketchbook paper with eraser ghosts
bestFor: ideas taking shape and before/after reveals
an ad that turns from sketch to colour at the reveal
suits: stationery, tools, furniture, architecture, design and maker products; thoughtful, crafted, honest brands
stylePara: Graphite pencil animation on off-white sketchbook paper: figures drawn with a soft 2B line that thickens with pressure and thins at the ends, with faint construction circles and searching double lines left in; shading in loose diagonal hatching and finger-smudged graphite, darkest in the core shadows; edges of the drawing trail off into bare paper instead of filling the frame; faint eraser ghosts of earlier poses; the whole picture is grey graphite, with colour used only on the product as a single coloured-pencil accent.

rendering.line: soft graphite line with pressure variation, doubled and searching at the joints, construction lines visible
rendering.shading: diagonal hatching in one direction, cross-hatching in deep shadow, smudged midtones
rendering.colour: monochrome warm grey graphite on off-white paper; one coloured-pencil accent reserved for the product (green bottle, yellow cap)
rendering.texture: paper tooth catching the graphite, smudges, eraser marks, a vignette where the drawing fades out
rendering.lighting: expressed only by hatching density; one clear light direction, the light side left as bare paper

motion: Animated on twos and threes with a visible line boil: every drawing is re-traced, so lines jitter slightly even on holds; hatching re-draws itself each frame instead of sliding; key poses hold while only the moving part is redrawn; the paper sheet stays fixed to the frame.
camera: Mostly locked, like a camera over a light table; slow push-ins; scene changes by the drawing building itself stroke by stroke or fading out to bare paper; no 3D orbits.
avoid: hatching that slides across a moving form like a texture
full colour leaking into the whole frame
handwritten words or notes on the paper
sheets: A pencil turnaround on the same paper (front, three-quarter, side) with construction lines visible and the hatching direction shown; the product is drawn in graphite with its coloured-pencil accent so the video knows which part carries colour.
risk: Seedance either freezes the line (no boil, so it reads as a filter on 3D) or lets hatching slide over moving forms; ask for 're-drawn every frame, visible line boil, on twos' and keep motion slow. It also likes to add scribbled handwriting in margins and to spread the accent colour; say 'grey graphite only, colour only on the bottle'.

example.prompt: Graphite pencil sketch still on off-white sketchbook paper: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and a top shaded as a mid-grey, drawn in a soft pressure-varied line with construction lines left in, holds a small glass bottle that is the only colour in the frame, coloured-pencil green with a yellow cap; a sunny kitchen sketched in loose hatching that fades into bare paper at the edges, a droopy fern on the windowsill in smudged graphite; eraser ghosts. Vertical 9:16. No text.
